definition: This dimension controls how weight affects inventory management, varying from weightless items to a complex system where each item has a specific weight that impacts movement and carrying capacity.
exclusion_criteria: All items are weightless or have no impact on inventory management
Inventory management is solely based on item count without consideration of weight
inclusion_criteria: Items have a defined weight that affects inventory capacity
Movement speed or actions are influenced by the total weight carried
title: Weight System Variability
